title: RIVER RUN
oneLiner: Hop past traffic and ride the river to fill five safe homes.
mechanics: Buffered four-direction eight-frame hops through four traffic lanes, a safe bank and four river lanes.
Cars are lethal; floating logs and turtles carry riders sideways.
Turtles warn before diving; water, sinking supports and drifting beyond the bank cost a life.
Fill five clearly drawn home bays; occupied or reserved bays cannot be overwritten.
Both cooperative players move independently and earn their own progress and home scores.
A clock and bounded lane acceleration create three escalating rounds.
lose: Traffic, water, drifting off the river or a timeout costs lives; the game ends when everyone is out.
scoring: 10 for each new forward row per crossing, 200 plus remaining seconds for a home; independent player scores.
note: Original Frogger-inspired mechanics and pixel art; no original game assets copied.
artDirection: Original green frogs with blue/red player markings, directional spread-leg hop poses, colored cars with wheels and glass, textured logs, and turtle swim/warning/submerged shapes. Distinct road, grass bank, river and five home bays.
